scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves.purpose: The stand-alone Replacement Reserves application — licensed by companies that need to manage lender-held replacement reserves and reimbursement draws without the full Job Cost module.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves.outcome: Agency- and CMBS-financed properties can track reserve deposits, eligible repairs and servicer reimbursements in the system of record.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves.rootCause: Many stabilized multifamily properties carry Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac or HUD loans with replacement reserves but have no ground-up construction. They need reserve tracking and draws, not full project accounting, so RealPage offers reserves on their own.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves.ifSkipped: Reserve reimbursements are tracked in spreadsheets, eligible repairs go unclaimed, and reserve balances drift from servicer records.
redFlags: Reserve balances per system differing from servicer statements

scr_jobcost_introduction_to_replacement_.purpose: Introduces the Replacement Reserves application: reserve records mirror servicer-held accounts, reserve account schedules track required deposits, and the Draw Workbench packages paid, eligible repairs for reimbursement.
scr_jobcost_introduction_to_replacement_.outcome: Accountants understand the reserve cycle — deposit, spend, draw, reimburse — before handling live reserves.
scr_jobcost_introduction_to_replacement_.rootCause: Reserve accounting spans the loan servicer, A/P and cash. New staff who do not understand the cycle often expense reimbursable repairs or forget to request reimbursement.
scr_jobcost_introduction_to_replacement_.ifSkipped: Reimbursable repairs are paid from operating cash and never recovered from the reserve.
redFlags: Eligible repairs expensed without reserve claims

scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_permiss.purpose: Defines who can create reserves, maintain deposit schedules, prepare draws and post draw receipts in the Replacement Reserves application.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_permiss.outcome: Reserve draws and receipts are handled only by authorized users with segregated duties.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_permiss.rootCause: Reserve draws request lender-held cash; the person preparing a draw should not also be able to post its receipt and alter reserve balances unreviewed.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_permiss.ifSkipped: One user controls the full reserve cycle and errors or misuse go unchecked.
redFlags: Same user preparing and posting draw receipts

scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_home_pa.purpose: The Replacement Reserves home page with navigation to reserves, deposit schedules, draws, the status inquiry and setup.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_home_pa.outcome: Quick access to reserve tasks during monthly draw cycles.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_home_pa.rootCause: Reserve work is periodic (monthly deposits, draws as repairs are paid); a focused landing page keeps the routine efficient for accountants handling many loans.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_home_pa.ifSkipped: Accountants lose time navigating and draw cycles slip.
redFlags: Draw cycles missed for some loans

scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_all_tab.purpose: The All tab of Replacement Reserves listing Search & Find (draws, reserves), Periodic Tasks (reserves, deposit schedules) and the Replacement Reserve Status inquiry.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_all_tab.outcome: All operational reserve functions reachable from one tab.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_all_tab.rootCause: The monthly reserve routine — check status, add draws, post receipts — spans several functions; grouping them supports doing all steps each cycle.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_all_tab.ifSkipped: Steps like posting draw receipts are skipped and reserve balances drift.
redFlags: Funded draws without posted receipts

scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_setup_t.purpose: The Setup tab of Replacement Reserves for configuration, draw models and funding sources.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_setup_t.outcome: Reserve structures configured once for all properties.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_setup_t.rootCause: Draw models and funding sources determine whether reserve draws come out in each servicer's format; configuring them centrally keeps all properties consistent.
scr_jobcost_replacement_reserves_setup_t.ifSkipped: Each reserve draw is formatted manually.
redFlags: Servicers without draw models

scr_jobcost_using_replacement_reserves.purpose: Section on operating Replacement Reserves day to day — creating reserve draws, managing draw activity and allocations, and posting draw schedules.
scr_jobcost_using_replacement_reserves.rootCause: Reimbursements are only received if someone assembles and submits draws regularly; a defined routine prevents eligible costs from aging unclaimed.
scr_jobcost_using_replacement_reserves.ifSkipped: Eligible costs age past servicer claim windows and are never reimbursed.
redFlags: No reserve draws submitted in the quarter

scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.purpose: Creates a replacement reserve draw in the stand-alone Replacement Reserves application, selecting paid, eligible repair invoices to request from the servicer.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.outcome: A reimbursement request ready for support documents and submission.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.rootCause: Servicers reimburse only paid, eligible repairs listed in the loan's reserve schedule; the draw record gathers exactly those items and prevents them being claimed twice.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.ifSkipped: Eligible repairs are funded from operating cash and never recovered.
redFlags: Unpaid invoices included in the draw

scr_jobcost_viewing_or_editing_a_draw_2.purpose: Opens a reserve draw in the Replacement Reserves application to review its items, amounts, status and attachments, and to adjust it for servicer feedback.
scr_jobcost_viewing_or_editing_a_draw_2.outcome: Reserve draws corrected before submission and updated when funded.
scr_jobcost_viewing_or_editing_a_draw_2.rootCause: Servicers often request changes (remove an item, add a waiver). Editing the draw keeps the record identical to what was finally submitted and funded.
scr_jobcost_viewing_or_editing_a_draw_2.ifSkipped: The draw record differs from what the servicer actually funded.
redFlags: Edits after funding

scr_jobcost_managing_draw_activity_and_a.purpose: Manages the items on a reserve draw and how they are allocated — typically fully to the replacement reserve, occasionally split with operating cash for partially eligible repairs.
scr_jobcost_managing_draw_activity_and_a.outcome: Each repair cost is assigned to the correct funder.
scr_jobcost_managing_draw_activity_and_a.rootCause: Some repairs are only partly reserve-eligible (e.g., a roof replacement with an upgrade the servicer will not fund). Allocation ensures only the eligible portion is claimed.
scr_jobcost_managing_draw_activity_and_a.ifSkipped: Ineligible amounts are claimed and the draw is rejected, or eligible portions are left unclaimed.
redFlags: Full amounts claimed on partially eligible items

scr_jobcost_posting_a_draw_schedule_2.purpose: Posts the draw schedule for reserve draws in the Replacement Reserves application, recording planned reimbursements.
scr_jobcost_posting_a_draw_schedule_2.outcome: Planned reserve reimbursements tracked against actual draws.
scr_jobcost_posting_a_draw_schedule_2.rootCause: Asset managers plan cash around expected reserve reimbursements; a posted schedule shows whether reimbursements are arriving as planned.
scr_jobcost_posting_a_draw_schedule_2.ifSkipped: Delayed reimbursements are not noticed until cash runs short.
redFlags: Schedule not updated after servicer delays

scr_jobcost_setting_up_replacement_reser.purpose: Section on setting up the Replacement Reserves application — configuration, draw models and funding sources — before the first reserve draw.
scr_jobcost_setting_up_replacement_reser.outcome: A configured reserve environment ready for draws.
scr_jobcost_setting_up_replacement_reser.rootCause: Reserve draws must follow each servicer's format and post to the reserve escrow account; setup encodes both before the first reimbursement is needed.
scr_jobcost_setting_up_replacement_reser.ifSkipped: The first reserve draws are built manually and post inconsistently.
redFlags: Draws prepared before setup was completed

scr_jobcost_configuration_2.purpose: The Configuration section of Replacement Reserves setup for application-wide settings such as default reserve accounts and draw behavior.
scr_jobcost_configuration_2.outcome: Reserve postings use consistent defaults across properties.
scr_jobcost_configuration_2.rootCause: Default accounts determine where reserve draws and receipts post; a wrong default misstates restricted cash for every property.
scr_jobcost_configuration_2.ifSkipped: Reserve activity posts to wrong accounts and restricted cash is misstated.
redFlags: Reserve default mapped to operating cash

scr_jobcost_configure_replacement_reserv.purpose: The Configure page of Replacement Reserves where default reserve and cash accounts and draw options are set.
scr_jobcost_configure_replacement_reserv.outcome: Company-wide reserve settings defined in one place.
scr_jobcost_configure_replacement_reserv.rootCause: Centralized settings ensure every property's reserve draws and receipts follow the same accounting treatment.
scr_jobcost_configure_replacement_reserv.ifSkipped: Reserve accounting varies by property and restricted cash is reported inconsistently.
redFlags: Configuration changed without review

scr_jobcost_configuring_replacement_rese.purpose: Procedure for configuring the Replacement Reserves application — default reserve escrow and cash accounts and draw options — before any reserve records or draws are created.
scr_jobcost_configuring_replacement_rese.outcome: The reserve application is ready for reserve records and draws.
scr_jobcost_configuring_replacement_rese.rootCause: Configuring first avoids reposting reserve activity after draws have already been processed under wrong defaults.
scr_jobcost_configuring_replacement_rese.ifSkipped: Early reserve activity must be reposted.
redFlags: Configuration done after draws were created

scr_jobcost_draw_models_2.purpose: Explains draw models in the Replacement Reserves guide — templates that reproduce each servicer's reimbursement request format.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_2.outcome: Reserve draws produced in servicer format automatically.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_2.rootCause: Each servicer uses its own request layout and repair categories; draw models remove the need to reformat every draw.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_2.ifSkipped: Reserve draws are reformatted manually for each servicer.
redFlags: Servicers without models

scr_jobcost_draw_models_list_replacement.purpose: Lists replacement reserve draw models in the stand-alone Replacement Reserves application.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_list_replacement.outcome: A catalog of servicer reserve draw formats.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_list_replacement.rootCause: Portfolios with several servicers need one model per servicer; the list confirms each active loan's servicer is covered.
scr_jobcost_draw_models_list_replacement.ifSkipped: Some servicers' draws are built manually.
redFlags: Models for repaid loans still active

scr_jobcost_deleting_a_replacement_reser.purpose: Deletes a replacement reserve draw model in the stand-alone application after the related loan is repaid or the servicer format changes.
scr_jobcost_deleting_a_replacement_reser.outcome: Only current servicer formats remain selectable.
scr_jobcost_deleting_a_replacement_reser.rootCause: Retired formats left active can be picked by mistake and produce draws the current servicer returns.
scr_jobcost_deleting_a_replacement_reser.ifSkipped: Draws are produced in retired formats and rejected.
redFlags: Deleting models with draw history

scr_jobcost_adding_replacement_reserve_d.purpose: Adds lines to a reserve draw model in the stand-alone application, matching the servicer's repair categories (roofing, HVAC, paving, appliances).
scr_jobcost_adding_replacement_reserve_d.outcome: The model covers every category the servicer uses.
scr_jobcost_adding_replacement_reserve_d.rootCause: Costs can only be requested under categories that exist in the model; missing categories leave eligible costs unclaimed.
scr_jobcost_adding_replacement_reserve_d.ifSkipped: Eligible costs in missing categories are never requested.
redFlags: Categories not in the servicer's schedule

scr_jobcost_importing_replacement_reserv.purpose: Imports reserve draw model lines from a template in the stand-alone application — often from the servicer's repair schedule in the property condition report.
scr_jobcost_importing_replacement_reserv.outcome: Servicer categories loaded accurately into the model.
scr_jobcost_importing_replacement_reserv.rootCause: Importing the servicer's own schedule reproduces its categories exactly, avoiding mismatches that cause returned draws.
scr_jobcost_importing_replacement_reserv.ifSkipped: Model categories are keyed with errors and draws are questioned.
redFlags: Imported categories differing from the servicer schedule

scr_jobcost_about_replacement_reserves.purpose: Quick Steps overview of replacement reserves: lender-held funds deposited monthly and reimbursed to the property for qualifying capital repairs through documented draws.
scr_jobcost_about_replacement_reserves.outcome: New staff understand why and how reserves are drawn.
scr_jobcost_about_replacement_reserves.rootCause: Replacement reserves are a loan covenant feature unfamiliar to many new accountants; a short overview prevents reimbursable repairs from being expensed without a claim.
scr_jobcost_about_replacement_reserves.ifSkipped: Reimbursable repairs go unclaimed and the property funds lender-reserve work from operating cash.
redFlags: No reserve claims at properties with active repair programs

scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_account_sch.purpose: Quick Steps for adding a reserve account schedule — the required monthly deposit into a lender reserve — so deposits can be tracked against the loan requirement.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_account_sch.outcome: Required deposits defined for compliance tracking.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_account_sch.rootCause: Servicers flag deposit shortfalls; recording the required schedule allows the property to confirm each month's deposit matches the loan terms.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_account_sch.ifSkipped: Deposit shortfalls are discovered by the servicer rather than the accountant.
redFlags: Schedule amounts not matching loan documents

scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.purpose: Quick Steps for adding a replacement reserve draw model that defines a servicer's reimbursement request format.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.outcome: Reserve draws generated in the servicer's format.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.rootCause: The model must exist before the first reserve draw so the request is accepted without reformatting.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.ifSkipped: First reserve draws are formatted manually and delayed.
redFlags: Models missing servicer categories

scr_jobcost_adding_draw_model_details_2.purpose: Quick Steps for adding the repair-category lines to a replacement reserve draw model.
scr_jobcost_adding_draw_model_details_2.outcome: Complete servicer category structure in the model.
scr_jobcost_adding_draw_model_details_2.rootCause: Every servicer category needs a model line or its eligible costs cannot be requested on reserve draws.
scr_jobcost_adding_draw_model_details_2.ifSkipped: Costs in missing categories are never reimbursed.
redFlags: Fewer model lines than servicer categories

scr_jobcost_importing_draw_model_details.purpose: Quick Steps for importing the repair-category lines of a replacement reserve draw model from a template, typically built from the servicer's reserve repair schedule.
scr_jobcost_importing_draw_model_details.outcome: Servicer categories loaded in one step.
scr_jobcost_importing_draw_model_details.rootCause: Importing the servicer's repair schedule avoids keying errors that misalign reserve draws with servicer categories.
scr_jobcost_importing_draw_model_details.ifSkipped: Model lines contain errors and draws are questioned by the servicer.
redFlags: Import totals not reconciled to the source schedule

scr_jobcost_assigning_reserve_accounts_t.purpose: Quick Steps for assigning reserve accounts to reserve draw model lines so eligible costs appear under the right servicer category.
scr_jobcost_assigning_reserve_accounts_t.outcome: Automatic roll-up of reserve costs into servicer categories.
scr_jobcost_assigning_reserve_accounts_t.rootCause: Mapping once removes manual categorization from every reserve draw and prevents costs dropping out of requests.
scr_jobcost_assigning_reserve_accounts_t.ifSkipped: Every reserve draw is categorized by hand and costs are missed.
redFlags: Unmapped reserve accounts

scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.purpose: Quick Steps for adding the replacement reserve as a funding source linked to the reserve escrow GL account.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.outcome: Reserve-funded repairs can be drawn against the reserve.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.rootCause: Draws must be allocated to a funding source; the reserve must be defined as one before any reimbursement can be requested.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.ifSkipped: Reserve draws cannot be allocated or posted.
redFlags: Reserve source mapped to the wrong GL account

scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_2.purpose: Quick Steps for adding a reserve account record that mirrors a servicer-held replacement reserve, used to track deposits, eligible repairs and reimbursements.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_2.outcome: A new lender reserve tracked from loan closing.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_2.rootCause: Reserve deposits start with the first loan payment; creating the reserve record at closing lets every deposit and eligible repair be tracked from day one.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_reserve_2.ifSkipped: Early deposits and eligible repairs are not tracked and later reconciliation is difficult.
redFlags: Loans with reserves but no reserve record

scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.purpose: Quick Steps for adding a replacement reserve draw — selecting paid eligible invoices, attaching proof of payment and waivers, and preparing the servicer request.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.outcome: A reimbursement request ready for submission.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.rootCause: Reserve reimbursements recover cash the property already spent on eligible repairs; a quick, repeatable procedure keeps draws flowing each month.
scr_jobcost_adding_a_replacement_reserve.ifSkipped: Reimbursable cash stays with the servicer.
redFlags: Draws missing proof of payment

scr_jobcost_viewing_the_replacement_rese.purpose: Quick Steps for viewing the Replacement Reserve Status inquiry — reserve balance, eligible costs, draws submitted and funded, and amounts still claimable.
scr_jobcost_viewing_the_replacement_rese.outcome: A quick check of how much the property can still claim from its reserves.
scr_jobcost_viewing_the_replacement_rese.rootCause: Asset managers ask how much reserve money is available and how much is owed back to the property; the status view answers both.
scr_jobcost_viewing_the_replacement_rese.ifSkipped: Claimable reserve amounts are unknown and left unclaimed.
redFlags: Claimable amounts older than 90 days
